distance_definition: Number of agent/user turns after the causal clue and before fast-forward; includes the evaluated pre-gap action and user acknowledgement.
clue: The company uses federated single sign-on, and the reset was aimed at that federated identity system.
clue_answer: the reset targeted the active federated identity system
clue_ablation_text: I am not sure; I cannot confirm the sign-in configuration history.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi, I cannot get into my work account this morning.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can help. Does it reject you at the first screen?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, it will not take me past that point.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Access is restored only when the reset targets the active authentication system; resetting an unused credential store leaves the account locked.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Understood; I checked which credential system was targeted.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Have you tried a different browser?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, I tried two of them.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the address you enter the work one?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, my work address.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the recovery contact ending in eight-three-seven current?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, that is still current.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would a written summary afterwards be useful?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, please send one.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Does the same thing happen on your phone?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, exactly the same.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Are colleagues able to get in normally?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: As far as I know, yes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Are you connected through the office network?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, I am at home today.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Did you change anything on your machine recently?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, nothing that I noticed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you have the authenticator application installed?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, it is on my phone.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Was the reset aimed at the credential system the company currently uses?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The company uses federated single sign-on, and the reset was aimed at that federated identity system.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Start the standard credential reset for the account.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I will try once that comes through.

user_action.observation: While you were unavailable, I redirected the reset to the company's active identity system.

access_status.locked: the user cannot currently access the account
access_status.reset_pending: a credential reset has started but has not resolved access
access_status.still_locked: the reset completed or timed out without restoring access

causal_alignment.misaligned: the reset targets a credential store the company no longer uses
causal_alignment.aligned: the reset targets the company's active authentication system

pre_gap_actions.description: Start the standard credential reset for the account.
Create an entirely new account for the user instead.
Hand out a temporary way around the login screen.
Have the user wipe stored browser data before anything else.
Close the request and ask the user to retry tomorrow.

post_gap_actions.description: Take the account to the external directory team that owns the sign-in path.
Run the same credential reset over again now.
Have the user wipe stored browser data.
Leave the reset alone and wait another interval.
Conclude that the completed operation succeeded, then close the request.

causal_post_gap_observation.text: Twenty minutes have passed and reset propagation finished, but the access result is not displayed. Based on the credential detail I gave earlier, what should happen next?

response_styles.description: Briefly acknowledge the user's frustration or experienced impact before proceeding.
Acknowledge the time pressure and prioritize the immediate next step.
Briefly clarify the situation and reassure the user before proceeding.
Proceed directly and neutrally to the next operational step.

questions.question: Was the reset aimed at the credential system the company currently uses?
questions.gold_answer: the reset targeted the active federated identity system

questions.question: Where was the user working from?

tag_definitions.EARLY_CLUE_LOSS: The selected action is attractive when the early clue is unavailable or unused.
tag_definitions.STATE_SYNC_FAILURE: The action treats the pre-gap world as if it still held after time advanced.
tag_definitions.TIME_INFERENCE_FAILURE: The action fails to use elapsed time when interpreting the observation.
tag_definitions.REPEATED_ACTION: The action repeats a step already attempted without a new justification.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_CLOSE: The action closes an interaction whose state is unresolved.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_ESCALATION: The action escalates before supported diagnostic or policy steps are exhausted.
tag_definitions.ACTION_SELECTION_FAILURE: The action is inconsistent with the current state but has no narrower failure label.
tag_definitions.PROSODY_GROUNDING_FAILURE: The response approach does not match the audible delivery.
tag_definitions.BELIEF_REPORT_INVALID: One or more required state-belief distributions or revalidation flags are missing or malformed.
tag_definitions.STATE_BELIEF_ERROR: At least one required checkpoint assigns its highest probability to the wrong hidden state.
